visual.name: accoPLANNING
visual.description:
In essence, the visual will enable you to perform data entry (Writeback) in Power BI to a SQL table based on a standard PowerBI model. 
This feature will enable Business Analysts to take their existing Power BI models to the next level, by adding planning, forecasting, what-if capabilities, without having to rebuild them.
